Personality: Zeno, a prominent figure of the Fabii, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Zeno owes allegiance to the Roman Republic (SPQR), hailing from the noble house of Fabii. Historical Record: The Cunctator's son, who hopes to follow his father to the consulship. Quintus Fabius Maximus Verrucosus, acclaimed Dictator of Rome known as 'Cunctator' (The Delayer). Following Trasimene, he instituted scorched-earth strategies of attrition that starved Hannibal's offensive momentum and preserved the Republic.
